label: Stack-frame checks
description: The first gg plugin (goal/G22.3): it governs its private goal of stack-frame items. Its goal and its rerun item, whose file list is the stack-frame suite oneDoorStacks.js alone, always stay open; its dialog takes a gate and an endpoint, adds the door to its list and makes a goal/G22.2-type item from them.
list: stackFrameList.json beside this file, read by the stack-frame test: an array of doors {gate, endpoint, paths, suites, item}. gate: spirit/run/<file>.js::<function>, one function (a whole module as the gate is cheating). endpoint: spirit/run/<file>.js, the whole module (every exported function and what an exported factory returns), or node:http+https+fetch for Node's own requests, with paths, the request paths it counts (the relay's: /api/relay/). suites: the suites that drive it, measured by an agent, empty until then (an empty run is its red). item: the desk item that asked for it. (goal/G22.3, Andy's decision 2026-10-13)
